newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends stronger, off peak.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends stronger, off peak.

text.p: London white sugar futures finished the day stronger but off their fund-inspired highs.
The spot October contract ended at $330.00 per tonne, up $1.30, after earlier touching a fresh life peak of $331.00.
December also finished firmer at $324.30 per tonne, up $1.00.
Steady buying by one leading commission house, thought to be on behalf of fund clients, fuelled the rise earlier in the day, but the gains were quickly capped by brokers and the trade.
In Paris, October ended 50 cents firmer at $329.50 and December $1.50 higher at $324.50.
